text: {"lessons":["Selling A, D, and E after gains and later buying A and D back at higher prices shows that anchoring trades to my average cost can lead to poor timing; I should decide based on each stock’s outlook and its role in my portfolio.","The recent decline in account value is a reminder that short-term losses are part of investing; I should review the underlying reasons and my overall risk rather than trade just to avoid regret or recover quickly.","Because I trade rarely, I should make any changes deliberately and with a clear purpose, balancing potential returns, diversification, and the cash available rather than reacting to monthly price moves."]}
